items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 22 October 2026 8:22am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 22 October 2026 at 8:20am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds later.


##Synopsis##

Very weak ridge of high pressure at first, with low pressure to the southeast of the British Isles progressing eastwards later.


##Wind##

West or Northwest 3 or 4, gradually backing South or Southwest through this morning and afternoon. Further backing and increasing East 5 or 6 this evening, then North or Northeast 5 to 7 tonight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building moderate later today and tonight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then heavy rain tonight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Backing North or Northwest 7 or gale 8 through the rest of tomorrow morning the decreasing West or Northwest 5 to 7 in the evening. Backing West or Southwest 5 or 6 overnight into Saturday.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, building moderate or rough tomorrow morning, then moderate again overnight into Saturday.


##Weather##

Heavy rain at first, then becoming fair.


##Visibility##

Moderate or poor in rain, becoming good.
